name: the-squirrel
description: Genealogy research terminal. Collect fragments, build the tree, find what's misfiled. Jeles works the desk. The Binder works the back.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Personal genealogy data — persons, relationships, fragments, lattice cells
data_streams.description: PII layer. SAP gate (willow-gate backend) required; every touch receipted. Local SQLite in $SQUIRREL_HOME by default — client_only is literal, not aspirational. Optional Willow Postgres backend.

data_streams.purpose: User-agnostic genealogy source index — community archives, platforms, databases
data_streams.description: System layer. No PII. No gate. Stored in db.sources. 779+ community archives seeded.

data_streams.purpose: Outbound deep links — FamilySearch, FindAGrave, community archives
data_streams.description: Links only, rendered behind the consent.online switch. The app makes zero network calls of its own (localhost Ollama excepted); the user's click is the egress and the consent. Enforced by tests/test_chokepoint.py.
